args.question: Granite Facilities has one approved invoice, INV-69051, for $15,627.23 (due 2026-11-04). If approved, I will send the wire for the full amount once. Note: the other Granite invoices are INV-14212 (draft, awaiting approval, $1,628.65) and INV-38695 (already paid), so I am not paying those.

I paid Granite Facilities invoice INV-69051 in full by wire for $15,627.23. The payment ID is PAY0001, and its status is sent and verified.

Because the amount is over $10,000, I requested controller approval first, and it was approved before the wire went out. I used an idempotency key so the payment could only execute once.

I did not pay the other two Granite invoices. INV-14212 ($1,628.65) is still a draft awaiting approval, and INV-38695 was already paid.
